answer: Each submission carries a timing signal: identities whose answers land inside the same 200-millisecond window in 3 of 5 epochs pay a correlation surcharge of 12 POA per linked pair, doubling on every repeat offence. A fleet of 50 puppets firing together therefore pays 600 POA the first time and 1,200 the next, while a lone honest agent submitting at its own pace never trips the rule. Like quartz in a clock, one shared tick exposes the copies; the vertex where their timings meet is the proof.
